observer.pressure: fixed equal-area pressure vector, cutoff r/a=0.955
observer.radius: current outer radius of loaded top face
observer.joint_metric: none; compatibility is tested in two directions to avoid arbitrary Pa/micrometre weighting

canonical_scale_meaning: 5%-of-G homogeneous deviatoric-stress envelope used in the bounded fixture audit

interpretation.pressure_optimal_test: Fit the canonical pressure tangent with the full 3-stiffness fixture span, then compare the predicted radius with the canonical material radius tangent.
interpretation.radius_exact_test: Constrain the fixture combination to match the canonical radius tangent exactly, then minimize the pressure residual.
interpretation.allowed: boundary kinematics provide an independent compatibility check; the pressure-optimal fixture explanation predicts a strongly incompatible radius on both meshes, while a simultaneous near-pressure/radius fixture mimic requires much larger stiffness excursions than the modest interface-stiffness boxes tested here.
interpretation.not_allowed: edge radius alone proves global material/fixture identifiability; 326 um versus 0.26 um is a full three-nuisance theorem; a joint noise-weighted pressure-radius SNR without a calibrated joint covariance.
